brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.

requirements.evidence: Single cell (piece:0,0,0;full) with top cover cover:0,0,0;full;top and all 6 side faces closed with caps (5× solid caps at 30/150/210/270/330 + 1× 1-hole cap at 90 carrying the vent) – meshClash clear, no open faces.

requirements.requirement: Louvred vent so board can breathe
requirements.evidence: Port louvre prop port:0#0,0#5 (hex-port-louvre) seated in cap 90's port slot – vents closed cell without letting rain in; visible in look and check_build clear.

finish.summary: Compact single-hex enclosure closed on all sides with solid top and 6 side caps, one cap fitted with louvre vent to allow breathing. Multimeter prop on top deck illustrates electronics use; interior void accommodates board.
